newsitem.title: GREECE: FINDINGS OF ASE BROKERS' AUDITS HANDED TO MINISTRY.
newsitem.headline: FINDINGS OF ASE BROKERS' AUDITS HANDED TO MINISTRY.

text.p: The findings of auditors KPMG, Deloitte & Touche and Ernst & Young who audited the books of the Athens bourse's 65 member brokerages were handed to the National Economy Ministry on Wednesday.
The three firms had been retained by the ministry to audit brokers after the Delta Securities scandal broke late last year.
The finding, numbering hundreds of pages, was handed to the Athens Stock Exchange, the watchdog capital markets commission and to national economy general secretary Apostolos Fotiadis.
But it will not be released to the public, Fotiadis said, as the information it contained was deemed confidential.
"The audits uncovered many transaction violations which however fall under the law of confidentiality," Fotiadis told Reuters.
He said the capital markets commission would study the findings and apply any pertinent sanctions to brokers found to have violated regulations.
Investigating magistrate Costas Ganiatsos who is looking into the Delta Securities scandal would also get the report on the auditors finding. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
